questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A person controlling traffic is ahead, usually in a construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles may be on the road ahead. Be prepared to watch for them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: The road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A narrow bridge is ahead. Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to road hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A four-way intersection with traffic from all directions is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings, and alert you to hazards or conditions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A road crossing ahead creates an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to respond to red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending soon. Be prepared to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. You cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A roundabout is coming up. Slow down and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: The road surface is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is for left turns only from either direction. Do not use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yield sign is coming up. Prepare to slow down and stop if needed. Let other drivers and pedestrians have the right of way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A steep hill is ahead. Be prepared for a downward slope in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle’s speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle’s speed.
questions.explanation: Start slowing down now. The speed limit will be lower at the next sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in construction zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal route. Be ready to follow the new, redirected path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign is posted near intersections to remind you not to block the path through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and check that the way is clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that buggies may be ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest legal speed for that road when conditions are good. You may need to drive slower if weather or road conditions are bad.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass these signs, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on collision. Carefully turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing is coming. Slow down and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive extra carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or steep downhill section is ahead.
